name: Blood Frenzy

boost.name: Secret Formula
effect: You may play boosts from your gauge as though they were in your hand. When you do, add the top card of your deck to your gauge.
HIT: You may transform a card from your hand.

name: Violent Transgression

boost.name: Faster Than The Eye
effect: When you set your attack, you may spend 1 Force. If you do, your attack has +1 Speed.
HIT: If you have 1 or fewer cards in hand, gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Explosive Cocktail

boost.name: Hidden Strength
effect: You may generate Force by spending 1 life for 1 Force.
HIT: The opponent must discard a card at random.

boost.name: No Escape
effect: As an action, you may name a card, then Strike. That card is invalid for both players during this Strike.

name: Eviscerate

boost.name: Instinctive Response
effect: After resolving an action that does not cause a Strike, if you have no cards in hand, you may Strike.
HIT: Both players draw or discard cards until they have 3 in hand.

name: Hydra Helix

boost.name: Obsessive Research
effect: Transform a card from your hand, then discard your hand.
HIT: Both players discard their hands. Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).

name: Metamorphosis
effect: HIT: Activate the opponent's Exceed Mode without spending their Gauge.
